single_change: On the same code path, retain and emit the best admissible candidate at candidate-budget exhaustion, or disable that behavior.

prediction.primary: The retention condition emits a terminally evaluable script in at least two of three cases after all three emitted no script in frozen P2.
prediction.paired: The retention condition reaches terminal evaluation on at least one more case than the no-retention condition.
prediction.mechanism_trace: Any retained script is labeled uncertified, preserves internal goal_status=blocked, and includes a typed candidate assessment.

non_claims: The three cases are consumed diagnostic data.
No per-repository rule may be added after execution.
